answer_raw:
The fastest option for running an LLM on DigitalOcean would be a **GPU Droplet** (pricing not explicitly listed in what I found, so check the official pricing page), which allows you to deploy models using 1-Click tools like Hugsening or vLLM [4].

For the cheapest possible deployment of a 7B model, you would need to look at **GPU-based instances** or high-memory configurations, as a 7B model typically requires more than the base 512MB or 2GB offerings to run effectively [1][2]. While the absolute cheapest instance is roughly **$4.00/month** (s-1vcpu-512mb-10gb, as of July 2026) [2], a 7B model will struggle or fail on such low-tier resources due to RAM requirements. 

To run a 7B model at all, you would likely need a droplet with significantly more RAM; as of 2026, a 2 GiB droplet costs **$12/month** [1], but for a 7B model, you would likely need to scale up to a higher memory-optimized tier or a GPU droplet to handle the parameter load and KV cache.
